height.description: Height of the form in pixels, returned as a string, e.g. "690"

status.description: Status of the form, e.g. "ENABLED" or "DISABLED". Forms whose status is "DELETED" are removed from the synced records instead of being saved

created_at.description: Creation date of the form in "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" format, e.g. "2026-10-01 14:36:20"

updated_at.description: Date the form was last updated in "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" format

last_submission.description: Date of the most recent submission in "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" format. Omitted when the form has no submissions

new.description: Number of unread submissions on the form, returned as a string, e.g. "0"

count.description: Total number of submissions on the form, returned as a string, e.g. "10"

type.description: Layout type of the form, e.g. "LEGACY" or "CARD"

favorite.description: "1" when the form is marked as a favorite, otherwise "0"

archived.description: "1" when the form is archived, otherwise "0"

url.description: Public URL of the form, e.g. "https://form.jotform.com/262715780901055"

Form.description: A form owned by the authenticated Jotform user

syncs.description: Sync all submissions across all forms in the Jotform account, incrementally by creation date.
syncs.name: submissions

id.description: Jotform submission ID, unique across the account (e.g. "6665953522666321061")

form_id.description: ID of the form this submission belongs to (e.g. "262715780901055")

created_at.description: Submission creation timestamp in "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" format in the account timezone (e.g. "2026-09-30 12:35:52")

new.description: "1" if the submission has not been read yet, "0" otherwise

flag.description: "1" if the submission is flagged, "0" otherwise

notes.description: Notes attached to the submission (empty string when none)

updated_at.description: Last edit timestamp in "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" format; null when the submission was never edited

answers.description: Map of question ID (qid) to answer entry. An entry only contains "answer" when the question was actually answered

name.description: Internal field name of the question (e.g. "q3_email1")

order.description: Display order of the question on the form, as a string (e.g. "3")

text.description: Label of the question as shown on the form (e.g. "Email Address")

type.description: Jotform field type of the question (e.g. "control_email", "control_fullname")

sublabels.description: JSON-encoded map of sub-labels for compound field types such as control_fullname (e.g. {"first": "First Name", "last": "Last Name"})

selectedField.description: Selected sub-field identifier for question types that expose one (e.g. control_autoincrement)

answer.description: Submitted answer: a string for simple fields, an object keyed by sub-key for compound fields (e.g. {"first": "Direct", "last": "Test"}), or an array for fields such as file upload. Omitted entirely when the question was not answered

prettyFormat.description: Human-readable rendering of the answer for compound fields (e.g. "Direct Test" for a full name)

additionalProperties.description: Answer entry for a single form question. The parent answers map is keyed by the question ID (qid) of the form the submission belongs to
